# Tuya TV Viewer v0.6.0: direct P2P video prototype

Prototype. Fixes the RTC request using the already verified Tuya Smart Java gateway, then attempts a full native P2P session. Reports actual phases (MQTT, SDP offer/answer, relay, and video packets) in copyable logs without keys or tokens. Attempts JPEG/MJPEG video; H.264 cameras are not guaranteed to work. Android name and package are unchanged. The debug signing key is not persistent, so uninstalling the previous build may be required. Android 7+ / ARM64.
